#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

class MinCostFlow {
public:
    struct Edge {
        int to, flow, cap, cost, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int rev) : to(to), cap(cap), cost(cost), rev(rev), flow(0) {}
    };
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    MinCostFlow(int n) {
        graph.resize(n);
    }
    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap, int cost) {
        graph[s].push_back(Edge(t, cap, cost, graph[t].size()));
        graph[t].push_back(Edge(s, 0, -cost, graph[s].size() - 1));
    }
    void bellmanFord(int s, vector<int>& dist, vector<int>& prevNode, vector<int>& prevEdge, vector<int>& curFlow) {
        int n = graph.size();
        fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INT_MAX);
        dist[s] = 0;
        curFlow[s] = INT_MAX;
        vector<bool> inQ(n, false);
        vector<int> q(n);
        int qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = s;
        for (int qh = 0; (qh - qt) % n != 0; qh++) {
            int u = q[qh % n];
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.flow >= e.cap) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                if (dist[v] > nd) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    prevNode[v] = u;
                    prevEdge[v] = i;
                    curFlow[v] = min(curFlow[u], e.cap - e.flow);
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        inQ[v] = true;
                        q[qt++ % n] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    pair<int,int> minCostFlow(int s, int t, int maxf) {
        int n = graph.size();
        vector<int> dist(n);
        vector<int> curFlow(n);
        vector<int> prevEdge(n);
        vector<int> prevNode(n);
        int flow = 0, cost = 0;
        while (flow < maxf) {
            bellmanFord(s, dist, prevNode, prevEdge, curFlow);
            if (dist[t] == INT_MAX) break;
            int df = min(curFlow[t], maxf - flow);
            flow += df;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevNode[v]) {
                Edge& e = graph[prevNode[v]][prevEdge[v]];
                e.flow += df;
                graph[v][e.rev].flow -= df;
                cost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }
        return make_pair(flow, cost);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int N, M, K, C, D;
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    vector<int> pos(N, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        pos[x-1]++;
    }
    int T = 100;
    MinCostFlow mf((T+1)*N + 2);
    int src = 0;
    int sink = (T+1)*N + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (pos[i] > 0) {
            mf.addEdge(src, i+1, pos[i], 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
            mf.addEdge(1 + i*N + j, 1 + (i+1)*N + j, K, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= K; j++) {
            mf.addEdge(1 + i*N, sink, 1, C * i);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        a--; b--;
        for (int j = 0; j < T; j++) {
            int cost = 0;
            for (int l = 1; l <= K; l++) {
                mf.addEdge(1 + j*N + a, 1 + (j+1)*N + b, 1, l*l*D - cost);
                mf.addEdge(1 + j*N + b, 1 + (j+1)*N + a, 1, l*l*D - cost);
                cost = l*l*D;
            }
        }
    }
    pair<int,int> res = mf.minCostFlow(src, sink, K);
    cerr << res.first << endl;
    cout << res.second << endl;
    return 0;
}
